_doc: The security headers of the web app's pages: the one list that the server (core/webheaders.py, main.py security_headers) and the development and test servers (frontend/vite.config.ts pageHeaders) both use.
_doc_help_csp: The help pages at /help/ (core/helpdocs.py): the built user guide. Its own scripts and styles from /help/, plus the SHA-256 hashes of the docs theme's inline scripts, which core/helpdocs.py adds to script-src from the built pages. The app's policy above never gets them.
